title: 日本ダービーの後に・超

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After winning the Japanese Derby, Narita Brian is focused on winning more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Expectations from fans rise again as talk circulates that she might be able to win five G1 races if she keeps up the pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon has just won the second tiara on the Tiara tour. The two of them decide to settle their rivalry at the Arima Kinen once both Classic Triple Crown series are finished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The challenge spikes Narita Brian's fighting spirit. Before that match, however, we have the Kikuka Sho—the final race of the Classic Triple Crown!
